settings.heading: Why we sort beds by how dogs sleep
settings.text:
Most of us take weeks to choose our own mattress and about thirty seconds to choose theirs. Yet an adult dog sleeps 12 to 14 hours a day, and most dog beds are bought on colour and price, with the size guessed.

Snoozly sorts every bed by the way dogs sleep: curled up, stretched out, leaning on something or burrowed under a blanket. Each product page explains which size to choose, and if you're still unsure, you can email us and ask.

Sleep needs every Snoozly bed is sorted into

settings.heading: Half their life happens in bed
settings.text: It's where they recover, wait for you to come home, and dream about the park. We think that deserves more than a guess.

settings.title: Sorted by sleep, not by colour
settings.text: Every bed belongs to one or more of five sleep needs: Calm, Support, Cool, Cosy and Stretch. You shop by what your dog needs rather than by colour.

settings.title: Sized properly
settings.text: A size guide sits beside every size button, and the Sleep Match suggests what length of bed to look for.

settings.title: Plain descriptions
settings.text: Each product page says what the bed is made of, who it suits and how to care for it.

settings.title: Honest about delivery
settings.text: Every product page shows an expected delivery window before you buy, including the few beds that ship from the maker's own warehouse.
